symptoms: Parabuthus species envenomation: severe localized pain, hyperaesthesia, autonomic/neuromuscular hyperexcitability, profuse salivation, diaphoresis, muscle cramps, restlessness, respiratory distress, heart failure

management_steps.details: Support ABCs. Local pain relief (ice packs, analgesia). Monitor vital signs, SpO2, and ECG.
Administer South African polyvalent antivenom for systemic envenomation (Parabuthus species) with resuscitation equipment immediately at bedside.

warnings: Have Adrenaline immediately ready due to risk of antivenom anaphylaxis.
